verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS agent platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents conversation retention settings: how long transcripts and audio are stored, with a 2-year default. That is an adjacent data-retention control, not an opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking, so it earns no credit. Nothing in the pack describes disabling telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
